rationale: Although the instrument shows strong relative strength against a weak broader market—trading at 97% of its daily range above both VWAP and the 5-minute 9-EMA on 2.95x relative volume—the portfolio already holds a highly correlated long position in GBCI (0.74 correlation). Adding long exposure at session highs duplicates sector risk while the remaining daily loss budget is constrained, and shorting contradicts the sustained upward momentum and tight consolidation near highs.
